messages:
elle: Quick FYI — started a regen for the new nimbus-2.1 embed bring-up on staging. Running the usual semantic-sim + cluster QA suite.

sam: Nice. Which quant config are you testing first? per-channel int8?

elle: Starting with PTQ per-tensor int8 (fast path), then per-channel if we see regressions. Command: `rwdctl deploy model=nimbus:2.1 --quant=int8 --env=staging`

marcus: Ran a small holdout of 5k pairs against prod-anchor set. Baseline (heron-v1 fp16) r@1=0.712, r@5=0.892. Nimbus int8 (per-tensor) r@1=0.702, r@5=0.888. Silhouette (kmeans 50) baseline=0.41, nimbus=0.39.

elle: Hmm small drop but within noise? What about distance distributions — any mean shift?

marcus: Mean cosine moved -0.008 across queries, small tail shift on short queries (<10 tokens).

jen: Did you check the calibration on multilingual anchors? We saw larger drift there last time.

sam: Good call, I did a quick sweep. For en/es pairs r@1 delta -0.015, for en/zh delta -0.03 (short queries again).

eva: Could be quantizing the first-layer projection differently for short inputs. Will try per-channel on the projector only.

ops-bot: Deploy 1718123456: started rollout to staging-gpu-pool-3 (3 nodes). Tracking logs at https://ci.internal/runs/1718123456 :eyes:

marcus: I also ran HNSW recall sim with PQ-derived index. With PQ-16 the r@1 dropped another ~0.01; with flat-vector index it's consistent with the earlier numbers. Might need higher-precision index for compact workflows.

elle: Action items: 1) eva to test projector per-channel int8 (only weights) and report r@k diff; 2) sam to run multilingual holdout 20k; 3) jen to run kmeans cluster stability plot and silhouette over seeds.

jen: On it. Quick note — clustering fragmentation appears for high-frequency anchors (top 5% doc length) — will filter and re-eval.

ops-bot: Alert: one staging node reported OOM during batchsize=64 runs. Recommend batchsize=32 for int8 path until we validate cache behavior.

sam: Will drop batch to 32 and re-run. If recall improves, we can attribute some regression to batching/caching interplay.

marcus: If per-channel fixes the short-query regressions, we can try a mixed config: per-channel projector + per-tensor rest to keep perf.

elle: Timeline: want a canary to prod-dedicated on Monday if we can keep r@1 loss <0.01 and no >0.03 multilingual regressions. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:

eva: Quick experiment log snippet I pushed to the run: ```
# nimbus projector per-channel int8
r@1: 0.710
r@5: 0.891
silhouette: 0.405
notes: short-query bias reduced vs per-tensor
```

marcus: That's promising. Please attach the eval CSVs to the run and tag me.

elle: Thanks team — looks like a reasonable path. If anything unexpected pops up, ping me @elle.

ops-bot: Deploy 1718123456: rollout complete to staging (3/3). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1718123456/logs

sam: Final note — I'll add a quick config in the model profile to default to mixed-quant for nimbus: `quant_fallback: projector=per_channel,default=per_tensor`

elle: Perfect. Closing thread after the canary results come in.
